summary: Retested all 7 fixes from iteration 2, plus a regression pass. All of them PASS. Backend: 31/31 pytest pass. I added 5 SSRF redirect tests and updated the CSP assertion. (1) SSRF via redirect is fixed: the httpbin redirect-to 127.0.0.1:8001 returns 400 'Blocked host' on both /api/proxy and /api/proxy/check. The redirect to 169.254.169.254 also returns 400. The normal redirect http://github.com -> https://github.com/ is followed (check reports final_url https://github.com/, embeddable false; the proxy returns 200 with the right base href and no Location header). (2) Proxy responses carry 'Content-Security-Policy: sandbox allow-scripts ...' without allow-same-origin. The base href is HTML-escaped (verified by a unit call of _inject with a quote payload). Frontend at 1920x1080: (3) a background window gets win-focus-shield-{id}. Clicking its content area brings it to front (z 2->4), and the shield moves to the other window. (4) Typing github.com in the address bar of a direct-mode window auto-switches to proxy: the iframe src is /api/proxy?url=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com, the PROXY badge shows, the toggle has theme-active, and GitHub renders. (5) Resizing to 390x844 maximizes all windows (390x760). Shrinking to 1000x700 clamps the window to x=0..1000 with h=616, inside the area above the taskbar, and the close button stays visible. (6) A maximized window is 1920x996 and the taskbar starts at y=1002, so there is no overlap. (7) New windows are 960x640, centered with a +28px cascade. Regression passes: the title-bar drag moves the window, the win-resize handle resizes, the taskbar toggles minimize/restore, the minimize button works, back/forward work, and close removes the window and the taskbar.

minor.issue: js_url in the injected <script> is only escaped for quotes and backslashes. A final URL containing '</script>' could close the script block. httpx normally percent-encodes < and >, so this is low risk. json.dumps plus replacing '</' with '<\/' would be stricter.
Still open from iteration 2: DNS-rebinding TOCTOU (validate then re-resolve), and the full body is read into memory before the MAX_BYTES truncation.

integration_issues.issue: After auto-switching to proxy for github.com, pressing Back returns to the original embeddable site (cineosweb.github.io) but stays in proxy mode, because back/forward reuse w.mode. This works, but the site is now proxied unnecessarily. Optional: re-check embeddability on back/forward too.

action_items: Optional: harden the JS string escaping in _inject (json.dumps plus escaping '</').
Optional: re-run checkEmbeddable on back/forward so non-blocking sites return to direct mode.
critical_code_review_comments: proxy.py _fetch: the manual redirect loop validates every hop correctly. Note that the 508 status for too many redirects is unusual; 502 or 400 would be more conventional.
useWindows onResize: windows stay maximized after growing back from below 768px, and the previous geometry is not restored. Acceptable.
AppWindow: the checkEmbeddable effect still has no cancellation (harmless).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_proxy.py (added TestProxyRedirectSSRF; updated the CSP assertion to expect the sandbox CSP)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the retest items (7/7) plus regression
